## Checklist

- [ ] This is a focused bug fix, **or** it implements an issue a maintainer has labelled `accepted`.
- [ ] It solves one problem only.
- [ ] I tested it (macOS version, Mac model, steps):
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo check --target aarch64-apple-ios` pass.
- [ ] It sends nothing off the device that the user did not start (see TELEMETRY.md).
- [ ] **Every commit is signed off** (`git commit -s`) under the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org). PRs with unsigned commits cannot be merged.
